```{r libraries}
library(haven); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(tibble)
library(lme4); library(lmerTest); library(psych); library(boot); library(car)
HAS_PERF <- requireNamespace("performance", quietly = TRUE)   # optional; only used for R2

# NA-safe standardizer (base scale() returns all-NA if any element is NA)
z <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

tidy_row <- function(co, rn, term, outcome = NA_character_,
                     sdx = NA_real_, sdy = NA_real_) {
  e   <- co[rn, "Estimate"]
  s   <- co[rn, "Std. Error"]
  p   <- co[rn, grep("^Pr", colnames(co))[1]]
  tv  <- if ("t value" %in% colnames(co)) co[rn, "t value"] else NA_real_
  dfv <- if ("df"      %in% colnames(co)) co[rn, "df"]      else NA_real_
  tibble(outcome = outcome, term = term, b = e, se = s,
         lo = e - 1.96 * s, hi = e + 1.96 * s,
         t = unname(tv), df = unname(dfv), p = p,
         beta = if (is.na(sdx) || is.na(sdy)) NA_real_ else unname(e * sdx / sdy))
}

# Random-effects variance components and R2 for a fitted lmer.
model_stats <- function(m, outcome = NA_character_, label = "") {
  vc <- as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(m))
  r2 <- if (HAS_PERF) tryCatch(performance::r2(m), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  tibble(outcome = outcome, model = label,
         n_obs = nobs(m), n_persons = unname(lme4::ngrps(m)[1]),
         r2_marginal    = if (is.null(r2)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(r2$R2_marginal),
         r2_conditional = if (is.null(r2)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(r2$R2_conditional),
         sd_intercept = vc$sdcor[vc$grp != "Residual"][1],
         sd_slope     = if (sum(vc$grp != "Residual") > 1) vc$sdcor[vc$grp != "Residual"][2] else NA_real_,
         sd_residual  = vc$sdcor[vc$grp == "Residual"][1],
         singular     = lme4::isSingular(m))
}
```
